title: Queue & deque
learn: FIFO, `collections.deque`, circular queue, why `list.pop(0)` is O(n)
hook: Queues are the engine of breadth-first search, which you'll use in trees and graphs. Knowing why `list.pop(0)` is secretly O(n), and reaching for `deque`, is a small thing interviewers notice.

explain.prompt: Explain the difference between a stack, a queue and a deque, and why you'd use collections.deque instead of a list for a queue in Python.
keyPoints: queue is FIFO (add at the back, remove from the front); stack is LIFO; deque allows both ends
list.pop(0) shifts every remaining element: O(n)
deque.append / popleft / appendleft / pop are all O(1)
queues power BFS and time windows; a circular array gives a fixed-size O(1) queue
